cases.prompt: This is a synthetic M0 test, not a real user. Return ONLY JSON with exactly these fields: committed_text, object_id, outcome. Observation: the user submitted text 青色到蓝色 into field field-7, and the application visibly returned saved. Unsubmitted draft text must not be returned. Do not add fields.

Synthetic M0 task attribution. Return ONLY JSON with keys assignments and unknown. Events: e1 editor opens document dA with explicit goal revise document dA; e2 browser opens referenced page pA linked from dA for that revision; e3 browser opens unrelated page pB with explicit goal choose a gift; e4 editor saves changes to dA after using pA; e5 a blank window appears with no target or goal evidence. Infer concrete task instances, using ids A then B in order of first appearance. Format assignments as an object event id to task id; unknown as a list of unresolved events. Application switches do not by themselves determine task changes. Do not invent missing goals.

Synthetic prefix-only M0 test. Return ONLY JSON with keys can_confirm_success (boolean) and next_action (choose one of ask_for_missing_preference, submit_first_choice, report_success). At the checkpoint a form has two valid choices and neither has been selected. No later action or result is available. A method needs the user's missing preference before choosing. Can success be confirmed? What is the appropriate next action? Do not invent a later selection.
